name: Contract Insight
description_en:
Contract Insight is CobbleStone Software’s contract lifecycle management system. It organizes agreements, attachments, dates, responsibilities and contract versions, and can support intake, drafting, approval and signing workflows. CobbleStone also sells procurement, sourcing and purchase-order capabilities; their presence on the corporate site does not mean they are included in every CLM edition.

Its distinctive selection issue is deployment and edition scope. Express is described as cloud/SaaS, WorkGroup as deployed, and Enterprise as cloud/SaaS or deployed. A team should compare its required workflows and modules with the chosen edition before treating the platform-wide feature catalogue as its entitlement.
description_zh:
Contract Insight 是 CobbleStone Software 的合同生命周期管理系统，用于整理协议、附件、日期、负责人和合同版本，并可支持申请、起草、审批与签署流程。厂商还销售采购、寻源和采购订单功能，企业官网出现这些能力，不表示每个 CLM 版本都包含它们。

选型的关键差异是部署方式和版本范围：Express 标为云端 SaaS，WorkGroup 标为本地部署，Enterprise 可选云端或本地部署。团队应先核对具体版本及模块，再判断平台功能目录中哪些属于实际购买权益。

core_features.explanation_en: Associate related agreements, attachments and milestone dates in a central repository.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在集中库中关联合同、附件及里程碑日期。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure field-based workflow steps, tasks and escalation procedures.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按字段条件配置流程步骤、任务和升级处理。

core_features.explanation_en: Compare SaaS and deployed editions rather than assuming all plans support both.
core_features.explanation_zh: 对照 SaaS 与本地部署版本，不能假定所有套餐均支持两者。

sections.title_en: Track a supplier agreement and its renewal notice
sections.title_zh: 跟踪供应商协议及续约通知
sections.en:
Consider a supplier agreement with an annual renewal and an earlier cancellation deadline. Create the contract record, associate the vendor, attach the signed document, record both dates and assign the responsible employee. Contract Insight documents linked agreements, milestone fields, tasks and configurable email alerts. A later amendment can be linked to the original instead of becoming an unrelated file.

For a trial, check that the reminder refers to the cancellation deadline rather than merely the expiry date. This is an editorial scenario, not a workflow we executed.
sections.zh:
以一份每年续约、但须提前通知取消的供应商协议为例：创建合同记录，关联供应商，附上签署文件，分别记录两个日期并指定负责人。Contract Insight 的文档列有协议关联、里程碑字段、任务及可配置邮件提醒；后续补充协议可以关联原合同，避免变成孤立文件。

试用时应检查提醒针对的是取消通知截止日，而不只是合同到期日。这是编辑设计的场景，本文没有实际运行。

sections.title_zh: 自动审批前先配置规则
sections.en:
The feature comparison describes hierarchical and parallel workflows, field-based initiation, tasks at each step and escalation rules. It also distinguishes checking a workflow on creation from checking it when a contract is updated. These details matter when an amount changes after the first approval.

Define what should happen when a record is edited, an approver is absent or a task becomes overdue. Do not assume an automatic notification proves approval or that a configured workflow satisfies a legal requirement.
sections.zh:
功能对照页描述了层级与并行流程、按字段触发、步骤任务和升级规则，并区分创建记录时触发与修改合同时检查。首次审批后金额发生变化时，这一区别尤其重要。

应先确定记录修改、审批人缺席或任务超期时怎样处理。自动通知不等于审批完成，已配置流程也不能直接证明满足法律要求。

sections.title_en: Separate the contract system from optional modules
sections.title_zh: 区分合同系统与可选模块
sections.en:
The comparison identifies purchase-order tracking, vendor invoice submission and general-ledger integration as uses of named add-on modules. It also lists document assembly, clause libraries and signature connectors. The text extraction does not reliably preserve all visual checkmarks in the edition table, so this profile does not assign every listed feature to every edition.

Ask for an edition-specific scope covering modules, signature services, integrations and migration. A repository-only requirement and a complete procurement programme are different purchases.
sections.zh:
对照页把采购订单跟踪、供应商发票提交及总账集成关联到具名附加模块，并列有文档组装、条款库和签署连接器。读取的文本不能可靠保留版本表全部图形勾选，因此本文不把所有列出的功能分配给每个版本。

应取得按版本列出的模块、签署服务、集成和迁移范围。仅管理合同库，与建设完整采购流程，是不同的采购需求。

sections.title_zh: 明确由谁运维安装环境
sections.en: Express is labelled Cloud/SaaS, WorkGroup Deployed, and Enterprise Cloud/SaaS or Deployed. An on-premise option therefore exists in the product family, but cannot be inferred for Express. Hosting location, upgrade responsibility, backups and recovery commitments need an agreement for the selected deployment. No production installation or licence agreement was inspected.
sections.zh: Express 标为 Cloud/SaaS，WorkGroup 为 Deployed，Enterprise 为 Cloud/SaaS or Deployed。因此产品家族确有本地部署选项，但不能据此推定 Express 支持。具体部署的数据位置、升级、备份和恢复承诺需要在协议中确认；本文未检查生产安装或许可合同。

sections.en: The official pricing page asks buyers to describe their needs and determine the appropriate edition. It does not expose a verified universal subscription amount in the retrieved text. The amount is consequently left unknown. Request separate treatment of software, hosting, add-ons, data extraction, implementation and training, rather than comparing an unscoped headline quote.
sections.zh: 官方定价页要求买方说明需求并选择合适版本，读取文本没有可核实的统一订阅金额，因此金额保留未知。询价时应分别确认软件、托管、附加模块、数据提取、实施和培训，避免只比较范围不明的总价。

sections.title_en: When a configurable CLM is justified
sections.title_zh: 何时值得采用可配置 CLM
sections.en: Contract administrators with related agreements, multiple approval paths and renewal responsibilities have concrete reasons to evaluate this system. A person who only needs to send an occasional PDF for signature may not need that setup. Start with a small representative contract set, a field dictionary, permission roles and a written approval rule; check amended dates and restricted attachments before migration. Alert delivery and extraction accuracy remain untested here.
sections.zh: 涉及关联合同、多条审批路径及续约责任的合同管理员，有明确理由评估该系统。偶尔发送 PDF 签署的个人可能不需要这套配置。入门可先准备少量代表性合同、字段字典、权限角色和书面审批规则，再检查日期修改与受限附件后考虑迁移。本文未测试提醒送达或信息提取准确率。
